radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Date: 20 Jan 2025 | Reporting Centre: OLVG Amsterdam

CLINICAL INDICATION:
Assessment for suspected malignancy alongside a documented PSA value of 0.2 and persistent elevation.

FINDINGS:
Glandular volume registers at 25.27 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus within the left peripheral zone, spanning base to mid-gland, dimensions roughly 12 x 10 x 8 mm. DWI shows pronounced diffusion restriction with matching low ADC values. DCE sequences capture early focal enhancement localized to the lesion. Seminal vesicles remain intact. Extracapsular extension and suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy are absent.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone (base-to-mid), measuring approximately 12 x 10 x 8 mm.
PSA density: 0.008
 csPCa probability: 0.64653254

previous_notes.text: Clinical review today confirmed a stable PSA reading of 0.4 ng/mL, aligning with historical trends. Due to his advanced age and enduring PSA levels, specialist assessment via multiparametric MRI was initiated. Continuation of routine hypertension and diabetes oversight remains within primary care.
